extDescription.message: Sync scrolling, link routing and saved pairs for Firefox's native split view.

cmdToggleSync.message: Toggle sync scrolling in the current split

cmdToggleLink.message: Toggle link mode: links in this pane open in the other

notInSplit.message: This tab isn't in a split view.

notInSplitHint.message: Hold the $KEY$ key and click another tab to split with it. Or right-click a tab → Add Split View.

syncRatioHint.message: Same relative position. Good for an original and its translation.

syncDeltaHint.message: Scrolls by the same pixels. Align once, then lock. Good for two versions of a page.

linkHint.message: Plain clicks open in the other pane. Hold any modifier to click normally.

restoreHint.message: Both tabs are open. Hold the $KEY$ key and click the right-hand tab to split them; saved settings apply automatically.

grantBody.message: Sync scrolling and link mode run inside pages.

notReady.message: Not available in: $SIDES$. Browser pages (about:, addons.mozilla.org) block extensions. Reload the page if it was open before the extension was installed.

notReadyFile.message: Not available in: $SIDES$. Firefox doesn't let extensions run on local files (file://). Open the page from a web server instead.
